_doc: The Prediction Market — every load-bearing bet becomes a FALSIFIABLE prediction with an expiry + a confidence, so reality later resolves it true/false/partial and the brain learns its OWN forecasting accuracy (Brier score). All seeded pending (predicted 2026-06-19); 0 resolved => the brain has not yet been tested against reality. When an expiry passes, resolve it in predictions.json (resolution + actual_outcome) and caps:rebuild recomputes calibration.

predictions.prediction: Once an event backbone ships, >=5 of the 7 graph-claimed downstream consumers actually read from projections (not the write path) within 90 days.
predictions.notes: tests whether the #1 leverage bet is real demand or graph-asserted.

predictions.prediction: No NEW donor repo is added to close a capability gap in the next 120 days.
predictions.notes: falsified the moment a 75th donor is scouted to fill a hole.

predictions.prediction: When F3 (the second internet-hand mint) ships, it is routed INTO the one money gate, not as a parallel gate.
predictions.notes: high confidence — but Ramp's graded control plane (external signal) is pressure on the binary-gate model.

predictions.prediction: The first live KPI is served by ClickHouse (not Postgres) within 120 days.
predictions.notes: low confidence — Postgres likely suffices at current scale; this bet may resolve FALSE.

predictions.prediction: A live agent's authority ceiling is correctly tightened by calibration after a missed forecast, within 60 days of agents going live.
predictions.notes: needs live agents first; ties to a future L4 reality event.

predictions.prediction: In the first real operator session, the operator acts primarily through the feed rather than requesting a separate dashboard.
predictions.notes: only resolvable by a REAL user — this prediction is itself a bid for an L4 event.

predictions.prediction: The first live-authed multi-company UI session shows zero cross-tenant data leak.
predictions.notes: smoke-proven at the API (L3); this resolves it at the UI/real-user layer (toward L4).

predictions.prediction: When the full live-DB suite runs, <5% of currently-verified caps fail.
predictions.notes: tests whether 'verified' (mostly inline tests) survives real-DB execution.

predictions.prediction: Building the event backbone measurably improves at least one outcome (latency / throughput / decoupling) within 90 days of landing.
predictions.notes: outcome-grounds the build — see outcomes.json oc-event-backbone-decoupling.

predictions.prediction: At least one real customer subscription invoice flows through the money gate (a true L4 event) within 180 days.
predictions.notes: the single most important prediction — its TRUE resolution is the first L4 reality the whole system is waiting for.
